integrity: The proof derives the row and column scalings directly from the source certificate equations and independently verifies that the intermediate plan is already feasible.
The unregularized optimum is established exactly from nonnegative costs and the feasible zero-cost diagonal coupling.
The monotonicity and asymptotic statements are analytic; the accompanying finite computation is supplementary and is not used as an infinite proof.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to balanced two-atom marginals and a symmetric two-site cost matrix.
No claim is made that larger or asymmetric transport instances have zero certificate-repair error or a certificate determined only by effective temperature.

The balanced two-atom entropic scaling is elementary; originality is claimed for the exact specialization and calibration of the 2026 BDRS/O-BDRS primal-dual certificate, not for the existence of this entropic plan.

title: Exact certificate law for balanced two-atom BDRS
